syllabus_topics: Basic terms and definitions. Thermodynamic system and its properties. Heat and work.
Postulates of phenomenological thermodynamics. First, second and third laws of thermodynamics for open and closed systems. Heat capacity and Mayer's relation.
State change and cycle, Carnot's cycle. Basic reversible and irreversible processes.
Gas models and state equations, ideal gas, Van der Waals gas, semi-ideal gas. Status changes of the ideal gas.
Irreversible processes of ideal gas. Mixture of ideal gases. Basic state changes in semi-ideal gas.
Steam. Demonstration in h - s diagram. State changes in steam.
Cycles of motors and machines - compressor, piston engine, steam and gas turbine. Reverse cycles.
Moist air. Basic variables and their measurements, expression of the basic properties of moist air. Processes in the h - x diagram.
Fundamentals of chemical thermodynamics. Thermodynamics of chemical reactions.
Basics of heat transfer. Heat transfer mechanisms. Conduction in solids – 1D cases.
Thermal radiation. Black, grey and real body radiation. Heat transfer due to radiation.
bibliography: Jílek, M.: Exercises and Labs in Thermomechanics, CTU Prague, 2007
